spawndoctor.anchor.none: No block anchored yet - sneak-right-click the block you want to check.
spawndoctor.jei.probe.what: Tells you why a mob won't spawn on a block. Light, the floor, the mob cap, another mod blocking it: it checks the same rules the game does and names the one that stopped it.
spawndoctor.jei.probe.anchor: Sneak-right-click the block you want to check, then walk 25 blocks away. Nothing spawns within 24 blocks of a player, and your own body takes up the space a mob needs.
spawndoctor.jei.probe.read: Right-click anywhere to read it. Search for a mob or pick one off the list. It remembers your pick between blocks.
spawndoctor.jei.probe.why: Green: it spawns here. Red: it never will. Yellow: something temporary is stopping it, like a full mob cap or you standing too close.
